alt: This FCC complaint details a carrier-level firmware restriction by TracFone/Straight Talk on a Moto G Play 2024 (model XT2413V) that prevents the execution of a Motorola-provisioned key.
summary: This FCC complaint details a carrier-level firmware restriction by TracFone/Straight Talk on a Moto G Play 2024 (model XT2413V) that prevents the execution of a Motorola-provisioned key.
full_text: Consumer Inquiries and Complaints Center... Phone Complaint... Subject: Carrier Firmware Interference Manufacturer Provisioning Moto G Play 24... Description: I am complaining about a carrier-level firmware restriction by TracFone/Straight Talk on a Moto G Play 2024 (XT2413V)... Motorola provisioned a key, but TracFone's firmware prevents execution.
